runtime_encoding: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless aligned uint64 source address

neural_action_decoder.request_count: learned Poisson distribution with unbounded non-negative support
neural_action_decoder.targets: free-running autoregressive learned mixture over direct signed cache-line deltas

captured_stride_actions_role: normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: captured Stride request count and direct target addresses as supervision only

lstm.architecture: single-layer stateful LSTM plus free-running autoregressive variable-cardinality direct-delta decoder
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology
